combo1.title: Gagaga Magic engine: Utopia Dragonar with Utopic Sage beside it
combo1.description: Going first with Gagaga Magician - Gagaga Magic, Zubababancho Gagagacoat and Utopic Onomatopoeia. Gagaga Magic summons itself and Gagagacoat, then Xyz Summons ZS - Utopic Sage on the spot. The Sage pulls ZS - Ascended Sage from the Deck, and Ascended Sage plus the Normal Summoned Onomatopoeia make Number 39: Utopia, which searches Ultimate Force. Ultimate Force ranks Utopia into Number 99: Utopia Dragonar with four materials. Utopic Sage stays on the field with no materials, and it still matters: if Dragonar, a LIGHT Utopia Xyz Monster, would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish Utopic Sage from the field or GY instead. On your opponent's turn, detach Ascended Sage and Onomatopoeia for Dragonar's Number summon and keep Ultimate Force attached for the Battle Phase wipe. Starting hand: Gagaga Magician - Gagaga Magic, Zubababancho Gagagacoat, Utopic Onomatopoeia. Deck needs: ZS - Ascended Sage, Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Ultimate Force. Extra Deck: ZS - Utopic Sage, Number 39: Utopia, Number 99: Utopia Dragonar.

steps.text: Activate effect: Gagaga Magician - Gagaga Magic in your hand.
Special Summon Gagaga Magician - Gagaga Magic.
Special Summon Zubababancho Gagagacoat from your hand with it. It is a Zubaba and a Gagaga monster.
Xyz Summon ZS - Utopic Sage using only those 2 monsters. Gagaga Magic's effect performs this Xyz Summon as it finishes.
Gagaga Magician - Gagaga Magic becomes material for Utopic Sage.
Zubababancho Gagagacoat becomes the second material.
Activate effect: ZS - Utopic Sage.
Detach Gagaga Magician - Gagaga Magic as the cost.
Detach Zubababancho Gagagacoat as the cost.
Special Summon ZS - Ascended Sage from your Deck. For the rest of the turn you can only Special Summon Xyz Monsters from the Extra Deck, and only Number monsters can attack.
Normal Summon Utopic Onomatopoeia.
Xyz Summon Number 39: Utopia using ZS - Ascended Sage and Utopic Onomatopoeia.
ZS - Ascended Sage becomes material for Utopia.
Utopic Onomatopoeia becomes the second material.
Activate effect: Number 39: Utopia, the search it gained from ZS - Ascended Sage.
Add Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Ultimate Force from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Ultimate Force, targeting Number 39: Utopia.
Special Summon Number 99: Utopia Dragonar from your Extra Deck using Number 39: Utopia. This is treated as an Xyz Summon.
Number 39: Utopia becomes material for Dragonar.
ZS - Ascended Sage transfers along with it.
Utopic Onomatopoeia transfers too.
Ultimate Force attaches itself to Dragonar as the fourth material. While it stays attached, Dragonar has the board wipe.

combo2.title: Same hand, going second: Ultimate Force on Utopic Sage into The Seven Sins
combo2.description: Going second with the same three cards. Up to the search it is the same line. Then Ultimate Force targets ZS - Utopic Sage, not Utopia. Utopic Sage is a Utopic Xyz Monster whose original Attribute is LIGHT, which Ultimate Force allows and Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Utopiforce does not. It becomes Number 77: The Seven Sins with two materials: the Sage and Ultimate Force. Detaching both banishes every Special Summoned monster your opponent controls and attaches 1 of them. Number 39: Utopia stays on the field with its materials, so both Numbers can attack, with 4000 and 2500 ATK. Utopic Sage's lock lets only Number monsters attack, which both are, and from the GY the Sage can still be banished to save Utopia from destruction. Starting hand: Gagaga Magician - Gagaga Magic, Zubababancho Gagagacoat, Utopic Onomatopoeia. Deck needs: ZS - Ascended Sage, Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Ultimate Force. Extra Deck: ZS - Utopic Sage, Number 39: Utopia, Number 77: The Seven Sins.

Xyz Summon ZS - Utopic Sage using only those 2 monsters. Gagaga Magic's effect performs this Xyz Summon as it finishes.
Gagaga Magician - Gagaga Magic becomes material for Utopic Sage.
Zubababancho Gagagacoat becomes the second material.

Detach Gagaga Magician - Gagaga Magic as the cost.
Detach Zubababancho Gagagacoat as the cost.
Special Summon ZS - Ascended Sage from your Deck. For the rest of the turn you can only Special Summon Xyz Monsters from the Extra Deck, and only Number monsters can attack.
Normal Summon Utopic Onomatopoeia.
Xyz Summon Number 39: Utopia using ZS - Ascended Sage and Utopic Onomatopoeia.

Special Summon Number 77: The Seven Sins from your Extra Deck using ZS - Utopic Sage. This is treated as an Xyz Summon.
